name: Love*Love Lydia-ryou e Youkoso!
original_name: LOVE*LOVEリディア寮へようこそっ
source:
A lot of teachers and students live and study at "Magic Academy". This is an omnibus novel featuring sensual love between male student and busty teacher with some magical help.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
